name: Glute bridge
why: Strong hips drive every jump and dive, and the bridge trains them with no load on the knees or back.

setup.space: Floor space about 2 m long to lie down.

steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat about a foot length from your hips.
Rest your arms flat on the floor beside you.
Squeeze your bottom and lift your hips until shoulders, hips and knees make a straight line.
Hold for one second at the top, then lower slowly.

mistakes.mistake: Arching the lower back at the top
mistakes.fix: Stop when the body is straight and keep the ribs down.
Move the feet in until the shins are near upright at the top.

parent_check: Straight line from shoulder to knee at the top
stop_if: Pain in the lower back, hips or knees, or pain that changes how you move
Chest pain, dizziness, feeling faint, a racing heartbeat or unusual shortness of breath
A cramp in the back of the thigh that does not ease with rest (end the set)

easier.use_when: The back arches or the back of the thigh cramps.

harder.variant: Single-leg bridge with the other knee held to the chest.
harder.move_on_when: Every rep clean in two sessions in a row, and the owner approves the change.

dose.tempo: up in one second, hold one, down for three
